name: Metapod (CobbleEffort form)
look: a purple shell studded with bright yellow warning spots
entry: Its shell is studded with bright yellow spots that shout poison to anything that would eat it. Inside, the toxins it gathered as a Caterpie are being brewed into wing scales.
how: Wild: uncommon in jungles, swamps and flower forests.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Butterfree at level 10.
